sources: Toma, Hancock & Ellison (2008). Separating fact from fiction: An examination of deceptive self-presentation in online dating profiles. Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin 34(8). 80 online daters (NYC), height/weight measured, age from driver's license; 81% misreported at least one; average discrepancies ~5-6 lb, ~1/3 inch, ~5 months; women understated weight, men overstated height. Via CBS News.
